map.Code128 条形码。专为开发者打造的在线工具，纯前端运行，代码不离开浏览器。: Code128 Barcode is an online tool built for developers. It runs entirely in your browser — your code never leaves it.
map.总模块数 = 11 × (1 起始符 + n 数据符号 + 1 校验符) + 1: Total modules = 11 × (1 start character + n data symbols + 1 check symbol) + 13 stop character
map.Code 128 的每个符号固定占 11 个模块（3 条 3 空，条宽之和为偶数: Every Code 128 symbol occupies exactly 11 modules (3 bars and 3 spaces, where the bar widths sum to an even number and the space widths to an odd number); the stop character is special and takes 13 modules. The check symbol is computed modulo 103 with weights: the start character has weight 1, and the i-th data symbol after it has weight i. Divide the weighted sum by 103 and take the remainder to get the check symbol value. When the input is purely numeric and of even length, this page automatically switches to Code C, packing two digits into one symbol for a shorter barcode.
map.物流与仓储标签：可打印 ASCII 内容适合生成快递面单与仓库周转箱条码；纯数字: Logistics and warehouse labels: printable ASCII text can be used for shipping and warehouse barcodes; even-length digits use Code C for a shorter barcode.
map.GS1-128 对接：在零售与医疗供应链中，Code 128 常以 FNC1 开: GS1-128 integration: across retail and healthcare supply chains, Code 128 often starts with FNC1 to carry GS1 Application Identifiers (such as (01) GTIN and (17) expiry date). These must be parsed by AI rules rather than treated as a plain string.
map.输入可打印 ASCII 文本（如 `ABC-1234`）→ 渲染 CODE128: Enter printable ASCII text (e.g. `ABC-1234`) to render a Code 128 barcode; the weighted mod-103 check symbol is calculated automatically. Even-length digits use Code C. This tool uses one subset for the entire string and does not support subset switching; the input field cannot accept every control character.
map.Code 128 的校验位怎么算？: How is the Code 128 check symbol calculated?
map.加权模 103：起始符权重为 1，其后第 i 个数据符号权重为 i，把各符号值乘: Weighted modulo 103: the start character has weight 1, and the i-th data symbol after it has weight i. Multiply each symbol value by its weight, sum the products, then take the remainder modulo 103 — that remainder is the check symbol value. Both the check symbol and the stop character must be encoded in the barcode, and scanners verify their consistency automatically.
map.Code 128 有 A/B/C 三套子集，怎么选？: Code 128 has three subsets, A/B/C — how do you choose?
map.本工具为整串选择单一子集：偶数位纯数字用 C，ASCII 32–127 用 B，: This tool selects one subset for the entire string: C for an even number of digits, B for ASCII 32–127, and A for remaining strings entirely within ASCII 0–95. It does not switch subsets within a barcode, and the text field cannot accept every control character.
